metadataRaw.title: How to INSTANTLY Fix Pinched Nerve Pain in the Neck and Arm
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to instantly relieve sharp, shooting pain in the neck and arm caused by a pinched nerve.

These exercises are especially effective for pinched nerves caused by a bulging or herniated disc in the neck (a common cause).

For best results, go through all the exercises and use the ones that provide the most relief.

Let us know which works best for you!
